items.name: Aasee Algorithms 2023
items.information: Herzlich willkommen bei der allerersten Competition in Münster in der Geschichte der WCA! Wir laden euch ein zu einem Cubing-Wochenende mit einer bunten Mischung an Events direkt am Aasee. Spannung und Spaß sind garantiert und wir drücken euch die Daumen für viele persönliche Rekorde. Wir freuen uns gleichermaßen über neue und bekannte Gesichter - wenn du Spaß am Cuben hast, bist du hier genau richtig. Bis bald in Münster! Euer Orgateam Welcome to the very first competition in Münster in the history of the WCA! We invite you to a cubing weekend with a colorful mix of events directly at the lake Aasee. Excitement and fun are guaranteed and we keep our fingers crossed for many personal records. We are equally happy to welcome new and familiar faces - if you enjoy cubing, this is the right place for you. See you soon in Münster! Your organization team

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. **ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge. **ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of its events.

items.name: Swedish Championship 2023
items.information: Välkomna till Svenska Mästerskapen 2023! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 7 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Det blir i år en 3-dagarstävling med alla WCA-grenar utom en, 3x3x3 FMC. Den Svenska Mästaren i den grenen kommer krönas på den separata tävlingen [Swedish FMC Championship 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2023). Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. Tävlande av alla nationaliteter är välkomna, men bara deltagare som representerar Sverige kan vinna medaljer, priser och titeln Svensk Mästare. ----- Welcome to the Swedish Championship 2023! Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 7 seconds or 5 minutes. This year there will be a 3-day competition with all WCA events but one, 3x3x3 FMC. The Swedish Champion in this event will be crowned at the separate competition [Swedish FMC Championship 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2023). We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. Competitors of all nationalities are welcome, but only participants representing Sweden can win medals, prizes and the title of Swedish Champion.
